image_prompts.prompt: The Dino-Racer Referee at the finish line, celebrating a great race. CHARACTER ANCHOR: The younger male paleontologist, dark short hair, clean-shaven, wearing thin-rimmed glasses and a tan safari pith helmet. He is wearing a black-and-white vertical striped referee jersey over a khaki safari vest. ACTION: He is beaming with a huge, joyful smile. He is holding a large, shiny gold trophy high above his head with one hand. In the other hand, he holds a checkered flag. SETTING: The finish line of the prehistoric dirt track, colorful tropical flowers and ferns in the background, festive atmosphere. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with rounded, toy-like forms. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' with celebratory sparkling lens flares on the gold trophy. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' centered, triumphant full-body shot.
